description.value: Laurelle's Fine Foods is a family-owned bakery deli operating inside the Granville Island Public Market since 1990, with an open kitchen where customers can watch baked goods come out of the oven fresh daily. The shop offers scones, muffins, cookies, pastries, salads, casseroles, and ready-to-eat meals, with a notable selection of vegan and gluten-free items. It sits just steps from the Granville Island waterfront courtyard — a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the False Creek seawall.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (100 spaces) at 55m; rack at 66m. Total: 100 spaces.
